title: DUTRA OS technical audit
statement: Audit of the actual DUTRA OS code/data paths used to establish current-state risks and assets before architecture work.

title: DeskcommCRM reverse engineering
statement: Open-source CRM studied as an engineering reference; patterns were extracted together with limitations and NOT CONFIRMED areas rather than copied wholesale.

title: DUTRA OS × DeskcommCRM gap analysis
statement: Capability-by-capability comparison used to separate useful patterns from unnecessary complexity.

title: DUTRA OS Architecture V1
statement: Approved architectural direction: evolve incrementally, use canonical relational truth and individual identity while preserving differentiated commercial UX/intelligence.

title: DUTRA OS Master Implementation Plan
statement: Turns Architecture V1 into small reversible packages across Foundation and Commercial Product tracks.

title: Implementation Package 01 report
statement: Foundation Bootstrap & Safety Gate implementation report including tests, environment blockers, rollback and intentionally deferred behavior.

title: DUTRA Builder Brain design review
statement: Structured review identified adoption, semantic validation, proportionality, metrics, provenance, human indexing and license-triage improvements for Builder Brain.

title: Package 00R reconciliation and release baseline
statement: Package 00R reconciled the GitHub baseline with advisory artifacts, contained XLSX risk, hardened local and Cloudflare state APIs, installed Builder Brain governance and established CI and release gates.

title: Package 04R durable sync bridge and conflict review
statement: Package 04R replaces silent conflict merge/resend with durable conflict recovery, explicit human review, authenticated foreground outbox delivery and serialized revision-aware writes while preserving local-first compatibility.

title: Package 05R controlled legacy reconciliation
statement: Package 05R merged through PR #9 after final CI, establishing a dry-run-first, human-approved and checkpointed path from legacy lead identity to canonical Company/Contact, with stale-plan revalidation and selective rollback safeguards.

title: Package 06R secure HTTPS preview runtime
statement: Package 06R published a protected Railway HTTPS preview and verified the live service, domain, healthcheck and deployed main commit while explicitly retaining filesystem persistence as non-canonical preview storage.

title: OG-18 smart Leads & Transcrição implementation
statement: OG-18 adds a deterministic smart lead queue over the existing state.leads source of truth, with separate conversation state, commercial status, origin and priority dimensions plus responsive filtering and client-sheet editing.

title: CIC-01 Next Best Action + Score Explicável closeout
statement: CIC-01 consolidated explainable prioritization and next-action context around shared deterministic contracts, then passed final audit before closeout on PR #23 without introducing a second score, queue or agenda.

title: DUTRA OS recovered conversation knowledge audit
statement: Recovered master conversation and technical handoff preserve historical decisions, bugs, playbooks and prior V3 migration context; they are evidence inputs but do not override current tested main or validated OG sources.

title: Live GitHub main audit for Intelligence Compiler
statement: Live repository audit established GitHub main at f4c2b3c68d747b6477410ffff50521d8788f8d62 as the current canonical code line and identified the existing Builder Brain, context manifests, knowledge services, current tests and newer Call Intelligence/Whisper implementation.

title: Call Intelligence and local Whisper production hardening commits
statement: Main commit chain 39be4d18 → 445ac095 → d631ef29 → af5469eb → f4c2b3c6 hardened signed audio upload, fact extraction, production metric hygiene and the local faster-whisper fallback, then added an opt-in production end-to-end self-test.

title: Live GitHub/Railway/Supabase technical recovery audit
statement: Live audit verified GitHub main and Railway production alignment before the Intelligence Compiler merge, persistent Railway volume /data, PWA cache v67, an active hybrid Supabase/Postgres backend, and a reproducibility gap: the remote Supabase project had 25 applied migrations and 13 active Edge Functions while the repository versioned only 4 migration files and 2 Edge Function sources.

title: DUTRA Intelligence Compiler V1 PR and CI closeout
statement: PR #104 merged the Intelligence Compiler V1 to main as commit 72354a1f04d6fdd5584fe876ec4b09bb050a312a after PR workflows Package 00R CI #404, Sales Execution P0 #24 and Call Intelligence V1 #22 passed; main Package 00R CI #405 also passed after merge.

title: CONVERGENCE-01 Stage 0 execution environment preflight
statement: CONVERGENCE-01 Stage 0 documented the failed initial cloud workspace with no usable checkout and unreachable proxy transport, followed by successful recovery in a repository-attached workspace with a valid Git checkout.

title: DUTRA OS master conversation recovery audit
statement: User-reviewed recovery audit consolidating the long-running DUTRA OS conversation into decisions, implemented work, failures, commercial context, technical mappings and pending work before chat archival.

title: DUTRA OS technical handoff 2026-10-01
statement: Technical handoff reconciled the recovery report with live GitHub/Railway evidence, distinguishing core main from the V3 shell and identifying current architecture, migrations, runtime state, bugs and technical debt.

title: DUTRA Intelligence Compiler specification
statement: User specification requiring project history to be compiled into the existing Second Brain, Skills, context routing, playbooks, incident prevention, prompts and tests instead of being left as chat-only documentation.

title: DUTRA Prompt Architect specification and implementation
statement: User-directed implementation adds a dedicated intent-to-mission layer that classifies prompt depth, routes minimal context and defines execution/acceptance contracts without duplicating Builder Brain or AIOX task packaging.
